release_notes:
Add DHRU Fusion Pro API type; remove dead Hot Fusion & CodeskPro types

- New supplier API type "DHRU Fusion Pro" (REST/JSON, Bearer-JWT): connection test, credit balance, IMEI + server service sync, custom-field sync/attach, order placement and status polling — full parity with classic DHRU Fusion, reusing the existing custom-field/order infrastructure.
- Widened the API key columns to TEXT (tbl_gf_api.APIKey + OrderAPIKey on codes/codes_slbf/log_requests/retail_orders) so the ~800-char Bearer token fits (migration + template.sql).
- Removed the dead Hot Fusion (type 1) and CodeskPro Server (type 3) API types and CodeskPro's dedicated files/branches.
